notes.title: SteamWorld Build is Out Now!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that SteamWorld Build is OUT NOW on PC, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch!

You can also find it on EPIC, GOG and Xbox GamePass! 

[previewyoutube=Enxq9uHyE0o;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What critics are saying:[/b]

[i]“SteamWorld has done it again”[/i] - 3DJuegos
[i]"A must pick-up"[/i]  - Tech Raptor
[i]"A delightful and very satisfying foray into the city-building genre"[/i] - Push Square
[i]"Seamlessly blends genres and ideas into a polished and premium package"[/i]- NintendoLife
[i]"SteamWorld Build is yet another triumph from the maestros at Thunderful"[/i] - Pure Xbox
[i]"A neatly-abridged take on what would potentially be a daunting genre"[/i] - Press Start

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35370473/d1465f73907376ce7f84481a15eddf135da207df.png[/img]

[h3]Not only that, but winter has come to SteamWorld with the first of our FREE seasonal updates! [/h3]

Turn your town into a magical winter wonderland with [b]Jingle Bolts[/b] - available now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5355153/4a43e83d013535990e175a5ff558e915de05f77b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5355153/5aae76773b0b4c3efeb906e4184950be3ec55ae5.png[/img]
[h3]Join the SteamWorld Community[/h3]
Find other SteamWorld Fans in the [url=https://discord.gg/zXbx57CKrq]Official SteamWorld Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SteamWorldGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SteamWorldGames]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/steamworldgames/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@steamworldgames]Tiktok[/url] to stay up-to-date with the latest SteamWorld News

We built Steamworld. Now it's your turn!
